description: Stores the buyer's own logo with Well Told and checks it for etching problems, returning a logo_id and plain-language warnings. Accepts a chat attachment (logo_file, where the app can pass attachments to tools), a logo_url the buyer pasted, or the upload_code from an earlier call. Called with no arguments it shows an upload box in the chat (with a secure upload page link as a fallback, works on phones) and returns an upload_code; calling again with that code returns the logo once the buyer has uploaded it.

logo_file.description: The logo file attached in chat

logo_url.description: Public https link to the buyer's logo file, only when the buyer pasted it in this conversation. Never a URL you found by searching or browsing, or a company website.

upload_code.description: Code from a previous upload_logo call after the buyer used the upload page

name: upload_logo
title: Upload a logo
